player_prompt.intro:
Yu bilong Pleya {player_id} ({piece}). Enimi bilong yu em ({opp}).
Sampasim muvim olsem '[a2 a3]' (from → to).
- Wanpela muvim narakain i go hed lon wan step i kamap klostu long wanpela ples we i no gat samting.
- Wanpela kisim i go daunim wanpela enimi pis na lusim i go long ples we i no gat samting.
Eriwanpela kisim i givim yu {score_per_capture} poits.
Gem bai i stap afta {max_moves} muvim o wankain taem pleya i no gat muvim gen.

invalid_move.bad_format: Pasin bilong raitim ol tok i no stret. Yusim '[a2 a3]'.
invalid_move.not_your_piece: As bilong piksa i no bilong yu.
invalid_move.dest_not_empty: Ples bilong go i no klia.

outcome.move_limit: Ol i no inap mekim moa.
